comment: Rogers is the sweetest woman you could ever meet. She loves teaching these classes and will always help if needed. She will make you focus during class and attendence is strict, but she is amazing. TAKE HER

She is great! She doesn't mind being called by her first name. SHe is very helpful and also extremely kind. She will do whatever she can to help. She cares. Elaine is a truly wonderful teacher who is very helpful and understanding.  Her class isn't hard as long as you put some work into it.  She truly inspired me to move on to become an art major at a different school.  I would not be where I am today if it weren't for her.  I still keep in touch with her and encourage everyone to take her class.
class is a breeze but dont expect an A unless you are an art major... be prepared to spend lots of time outside class working on projects
